name: warderbox
summary: AI agent safety platform: pre-execution cost estimation, execution timeout, idempotency guard, output validation, fallback routing, quotas, smart model routing, cost anomaly detection, rollback, budget control, circuit breakers, tracing, compliance, and chaos testing.
